reason: The open panel's layout grid of its columns and its n-gram section; a pure layout box with no meaning of its own.
The panel grid's three columns, which stack or sit side by side with its width; layout only, without a heading to make each a section.
The grid worst_groups.js fills with its titled n-gram cards (sections), itself inside the titled n-gram section: a layout box, no element means a grid of cards.
The decorative ▲ or ▼ beside a change, aria-hidden and said in words by the cell's screen-reader text; no element carries a decorative glyph.
Text for screen readers only (the verdict in words, a finger's ideal load), visually hidden; it is inline text inside a cell, with no meaning beyond the words.
The coloured fill of a finger's load bar inside its aria-hidden track; a purely visual shape (a meter cannot draw the ideal-load mark across it).
The ideal-load mark drawn across a finger's bar, inside its aria-hidden track; a positioned visual line, said in words in the value's cell.
The decorative ↔, → and ↺ between the keys of a swap or a cycle, coloured, inside the aria-hidden drawing that the cycle's sentence and the « Apply » name say in words.
The decorative ▲ of a swap's gain, aria-hidden and said in words by the gain's screen-reader text; no element carries a decorative glyph.
Text for screen readers only (a cycle's moves, the gain's verdict in words), visually hidden; inline words with no meaning of their own.
The named group (role group) of the PNG and SVG save buttons and their status, a button row; a fieldset's legend would leave the row's flex layout.
The group's visible caption, aria-hidden since the group carries the same name; a legend needs a fieldset and a label names one control, not a group of buttons.
The aria-hidden bar of an n-gram's share inside its button, a purely visual shape; the share is said in the button's text and name.
The board on which the key buttons are absolutely positioned, sized by the script; a drawing surface with no meaning of its own (the keys carry the names).
The visible button face of the import label (the native file input's own words stay hidden): the label element is the control's name, the face is only its look.
Groups the popover's explanation paragraphs, replaced together on each opening; it is no section (no heading of its own) and no other element means a run of paragraphs.
